lessons.key: ac_gap::when an acceptance criterion lists multiple failure sub cases for one field e g not parseable vs parseable but missing x write a distinct test per sub case rather than one representative test per field
lessons.text: When an acceptance criterion lists multiple failure sub-cases for one field (e.g. not-parseable vs. parseable-but-missing-X), write a distinct test per sub-case rather than one representative test per field.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::before writing an acceptance criterion that names two distinct failure triggers e g broker unreachable vs delivery timeout confirm the planned implementation actually has two distinct code paths for them or phrase it as one ac to avoid an unfalsifiable precision gap at validation time
lessons.text: Before writing an acceptance criterion that names two distinct failure triggers (e.g. broker-unreachable vs. delivery-timeout), confirm the planned implementation actually has two distinct code paths for them, or phrase it as one AC to avoid an unfalsifiable precision gap at validation time.
evidence: spec.md P1 'Publish failure is never silently accepted' AC4 (spec-writing)
